entities.summary: The Mosque of the Bois de Vincennes, also known as the Mosque of the Colonial Garden Hospital or Nogent Mosque was a former Islamic mosque, located in the grounds of the Bois de Vincennes, in greater Paris, France. It was the first mosque built on the French mainland since the Umayyad invasion of Gaul in the 8th century.
